cited_passage: IRS, "Check your eligibility for the new enhanced deduction for seniors," IRS Newsroom (Feb. 27, 2026) — $6,000 per individual 65+ ($12,000 for qualifying married couples); reduces taxable income (not AGI, per IRS FS-2026-04); MAGI phaseout at $75,000/$150,000; effective 2025–2028. Source: irs.gov/newsroom/check-your-eligibility-for-the-new-enhanced-deduction-for-seniors.
